propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts for identical inputs (PASS vs FAIL) on consecutive runs without intervening code changes, rendering the close gate unreliable for both false-blocking and false-passing.

The verifier's test-existence criteria flip between unmet and met across runs due to variable LLM sampling and the agent's free-form search strategy, which sometimes queries literal substrings and sometimes semantic/regex patterns that both fail to locate existing tests.
The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar does not record verified_at_sha or trace_id, preventing post-hoc diagnosis of whether non-determinism stems from input drift or genuine sampling variance.

Pinning model temperature to 0 (greedy decoding) by default in _verify_completion_inner, unless explicitly overridden by REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE, will reduce sampling variance on borderline test-existence judgments.

Recording verified_at_sha and trace_id in both PASS and FAIL completion-verdict payloads will enable future detection of input-identity on identical stored records, proving determinism defects from sidecar data alone.
